card.name: Science DOI numbers and mixed link words
card.fires_on: Mostly the digits and dot inside a Science journal DOI (10.1126/science.1213775) in reference lists. Also fires on a few small linking words (of, to, which, otherwise) in legal or news prose.

modes.label: Science DOI
modes.description: The dot or first digit right after 'science' in a 10.1126/science DOI.

modes.label: Linking words in legal/news text
modes.description: Small words like of, to, which or otherwise before a consequence such as life, danger or patent protection.
modes.example: at the cost<< of>> their right to life.
